prose.text:
To study the magnitude and direction of surface tension, the textbook uses a rectangular metal frame with a movable side of length $l$, labeled $AB$, that can move in a vertical plane with little friction (Figure 69).
Once a soap film forms in the frame, wire $AB$ tends to move as the film tends to reduce its surface area.
The film's force on wire $AB$ lies in the film's plane and is perpendicular to the wire.

A resultant force $\vec F_1$ opposing the film's pull keeps the wire in equilibrium, allowing surface tension to be studied through the balance of forces.
To provide $\vec F_1$, the textbook attaches a soft spring fixed to a stand to the wire (Figure 69).
Here, $\vec F_1$ is the combined force of the spring and the wire's weight, not necessarily the spring force alone.

When wire $AB$ is in equilibrium, the textbook's vector convention gives:
$\vec F_1=-2\vec F$.
The minus sign indicates opposite directions, and the factor comes from the film's two surfaces.
It does not mean that the tension of a single interface automatically doubles.
prose.source_text: 为了求出表面张力的大小和方向，我们取一个直角形金属框架，长为 $l$ 的一个边 $AB$，可以在竖直平面内移动，摩擦很小（图 69）. 把框架在盛有肥皂溶液的容器里浸一下以后，在框架上可以得到一个肥皂薄膜. 此后，马上会看到导线 $AB$ 在运动，肥皂薄膜收缩自己的表面. 因此，薄膜给导线 $AB$ 一个垂直于导线方向的作用力，这就是表面张力. 对导线施力$\vec F_1$ 使导线保持平衡以后，可以测量出表面张力. 为了产生力$\vec F_1$，可以把固定在铁架台上的软弹簧系在导线上（图69）. 弹簧的弹性力和导线所受的重力的合力是 $\vec F_1$. 为了使导线 $AB$处于平衡，必须使得$\vec F_1=-2\vec F$，

prose.text: Figure 69
prose.label: 图 69

prose.text: Figure 70
prose.label: 图 70

prose.text:
Here, $\vec F$ is the force exerted on the wire by one of the film's two surfaces (Figure 70).
When conditions at the two interfaces, where the film meets its surroundings, are the same, their forces have equal magnitudes and point in the same direction in the illustrated geometry, so they add.
The two-interface factor for this soap film cannot be applied unconditionally to a single interface.
prose.source_text: 式中 $\vec F$——薄膜两个表面中的一个表面对导线作用的表面张力（图 70）.

prose.text:
When the wire moves downward through a distance $h$, suppose the motion is approximately quasistatic: slow enough to remain close to equilibrium.
The magnitude of the balancing external resultant is $F_1=2F$, and its work is:
$A=F_1h=2Fh.$
(5-2)

This work is done by the combined spring force and weight.
The gravitational work for the same displacement must not be added again.
During downward extension, the external resultant and displacement point in the same direction, so this work is positive; the film's opposing pull does negative work.

The work expression also assumes negligible friction and viscous losses, meaning energy dissipated by the liquid's resistance to flow.
Interface conditions must remain stable and the force approximately constant.
prose.source_text: 当导线向下移动距离 $h$ 时，外力 $F_1=2F$ 做功，$A=F_1h=2Fh.$ （5-2）

prose.text:
In this model, the external work increases the film's surface-energy contribution.
The textbook calls this "surface energy".
More precisely, for a reversible process at constant temperature, the surface work corresponds to an increase in surface free energy, the energy measure relevant to reversible work under these conditions.

It should not be equated unconditionally with the change in the whole system's internal energy.
Initially, the area of one surface is $S_1$, and the textbook writes the film's surface energy as $U_{\text{surface}1}=2\sigma S_1$ because the film has two surfaces of equal area.
It writes the final surface energy as $U_{\text{surface}2}=2\sigma S_2$.

These expressions assume an approximately constant surface tension coefficient, with temperature and composition stable and the surrounding medium unchanged.
Thus:
prose.source_text: 根据能量守恒定律，这个功等于（在这种表面情况下）薄膜能量的变化量. 开始时面积为 $S_1$ 的肥皂薄膜的表面能等于 $U_{\text{п}1}=2\sigma S_1$，因为薄膜具有两个相同面积的表面. 最后的表面能为 $U_{\text{п}2}=2\sigma S_2$. 因此，

prose.text: $A=U_{\text{surface}2}-U_{\text{surface}1}=2\sigma S_2-2\sigma S_1=2\sigma(S_2-S_1).$

As the wire moves downward, taking its displacement as positive, the increase in one surface's area is the wire's length multiplied by its displacement.
Using the initial and final area notation above:
$S_2-S_1=lh$.

Substituting this into the surface-work expression gives:

$A=2\sigma lh.$
(5-3)
Comparing the right-hand sides of the textbook's work expressions (5-2) and (5-3) gives:
prose.source_text: 由于表示式（5-2）和（5-3）的右边相等，则得

prose.text: $2Fh=2\sigma lh.$

This gives the relation between force and boundary length.
For the uniform, flat interface considered here, the magnitude of the force exerted by one surface on a boundary of length $l$ is:
prose.source_text: 由此得出，作用在长为 $l$ 的表面层边界上的表面张力等于

prose.text:
$F=\sigma l.$
(5-4)

Surface tension acts tangentially to the liquid surface and perpendicular to the chosen surface boundary.
In Figures 69 and 70, this means within the film's plane and perpendicular to wire $AB$.
For a curved surface, use the local tangent plane and the boundary's direction at each point.

Forces along different boundary segments cannot simply be added without considering their directions.
The boundary length here is the length of contact between one surface and the movable wire, not the entire frame's perimeter.
Under the same interface conditions, the force magnitude is proportional to this boundary length, with surface tension coefficient $\sigma$ as the proportionality constant.

The force-to-boundary-length relation in formula (5-4) gives units of newtons per meter.
These are equivalent to joules per square meter from the surface-energy viewpoint, since J/m$^2=$N m/m$^2$ $=$N/m.
prose.source_text: 同时，表面张力的方向是沿着表面切线垂直于表面层的边界（在所讨论的情况下，是垂直于导线 $AB$，参阅图 69, 70）.力与长度成正比，而比例系数 $\sigma$ 是表面张力系数. 根据公式（5-4），表面张力系数的单位不用焦耳每平方米，而用牛顿每米. 这两个单位是相等的，因为焦耳/米$^2=$牛顿·米/米$^2$ $=$牛顿/米.

prose.text:
The textbook's appendix lists surface tension coefficients for several liquids at their interfaces with air.
Using these values requires retaining the corresponding liquid, interface, and measurement conditions.
A value for a liquid-air interface cannot be transferred unconditionally to that liquid's interface with another medium.

The original appendix is the source for these values; none are specified in this passage.
prose.source_text: 在书末附表中，列出了几种液体（在它们与空气的分界面上）的表面张力系数的数值.

data.chapter: 第五章　液体的表面现象
data.title: 表面张力

prose.text: 为了求出表面张力的大小和方向，我们取一个直角形金属框架，长为 $l$ 的一个边 $AB$，可以在竖直平面内移动，摩擦很小（图 69）. 把框架在盛有肥皂溶液的容器里浸一下以后，在框架上可以得到一个肥皂薄膜. 此后，马上会看到导线 $AB$ 在运动，肥皂薄膜收缩自己的表面. 因此，薄膜给导线 $AB$ 一个垂直于导线方向的作用力，这就是表面张力. 对导线施力$\vec F_1$ 使导线保持平衡以后，可以测量出表面张力. 为了产生力$\vec F_1$，可以把固定在铁架台上的软弹簧系在导线上（图69）. 弹簧的弹性力和导线所受的重力的合力是 $\vec F_1$. 为了使导线 $AB$处于平衡，必须使得$\vec F_1=-2\vec F$，
式中 $\vec F$——薄膜两个表面中的一个表面对导线作用的表面张力（图 70）.
当导线向下移动距离 $h$ 时，外力 $F_1=2F$ 做功，$A=F_1h=2Fh.$ （5-2）
根据能量守恒定律，这个功等于（在这种表面情况下）薄膜能量的变化量. 开始时面积为 $S_1$ 的肥皂薄膜的表面能等于 $U_{\text{п}1}=2\sigma S_1$，因为薄膜具有两个相同面积的表面. 最后的表面能为 $U_{\text{п}2}=2\sigma S_2$. 因此，
$A=U_{\text{п}2}-U_{\text{п}1}=2\sigma S_2-2\sigma S_1=2\sigma(S_2-S_1).$
因为 $S_1-S_2=lh$，所以
$A=2\sigma lh.$ （5-3）
由于表示式（5-2）和（5-3）的右边相等，则得
$2Fh=2\sigma lh.$
由此得出，作用在长为 $l$ 的表面层边界上的表面张力等于
$F=\sigma l.$ （5-4）
同时，表面张力的方向是沿着表面切线垂直于表面层的边界（在所讨论的情况下，是垂直于导线 $AB$，参阅图 69, 70）.力与长度成正比，而比例系数 $\sigma$ 是表面张力系数. 根据公式（5-4），表面张力系数的单位不用焦耳每平方米，而用牛顿每米. 这两个单位是相等的，因为焦耳/米$^2=$牛顿·米/米$^2$ $=$牛顿/米.
在书末附表中，列出了几种液体（在它们与空气的分界面上）的表面张力系数的数值.

section_breaks.before:
式中 $\vec F$ 是液膜两个表面中的一个表面对导线的作用力（图 70）。
在两侧界面条件相同的近似下，两个表面的作用力大小相同，在图示几何关系中的方向相同，因此要把它们叠加。
这里讨论的是有两个界面的肥皂液膜，不能把这两个表面的因子无条件套用到只有一个界面的情形。
section_breaks.after:
当导线以近似准静态方式向下移动距离 $h$ 时，使它与液膜拉力平衡的外力合力大小为 $F_1=2F$，其做功为：
$A=F_1h=2Fh.$
（5-2）

section_breaks.before: 这条做功式还采用摩擦和黏滞损耗可忽略、界面条件相应稳定以及力近似不变的模型。
section_breaks.after:
在上述准静态、损耗可忽略的模型中，这部分外力功用于增加液膜的表面能量项。
原书用“表面能”描述它；
在严格的恒温可逆描述中，相应表面功对应表面自由能的增加，不能无条件把它等同于整个系统内能的变化。
由此给出的力与边界长度关系是：在本课均匀、平直的界面条件下，一个表面对长为 $l$ 的边界所施加的力大小为：

表面张力的方向沿液体表面的切线，并垂直于所取的表面边界；
在图 69、70 的情形中，就是在液膜平面内垂直于导线 $AB$。
对曲面，应按边界处的局部切面和边界方向理解这句话；

errata.reason: Initial independent SCI finding F1: S1 is the initial area and S2 the final area of one film face. A positive downward displacement h of a wire of length l increases that face's area by lh. The printed initial-minus-final order conflicts with this area increase and the surrounding positive-work expression using final-minus-initial area. Correct only this complete formula in the modern edition; preserve all raw printed body, blocks, other equations, counting and crops.
